2.163.27
GaugePanel.GaugeLabels
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.GaugeLabels element specifies the set of gauge labels in a GaugePanel. The
GaugePanel.GaugeLabels element is optional. This element is of type GaugeLabels.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.GaugeLabels element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.GaugeLabels element.
 <xsd:element name="GaugeLabels" type="GaugeLabelsType" minOccurs="0">
